findings.title: Duplicate Default Routing Rules
findings.description: Organization 2 has 4 'catch-all' default routing rules (expediteur_id and groupe_id are NULL). Each organization should have exactly one default rule to ensure deterministic message routing.
findings.impact_estimate: Non-deterministic routing behavior for messages that do not match specific rules, potentially leading to inconsistent SMS gateway selection.

evidence.query: SELECT organization_id, COUNT(*) FROM smsc_routing_rule WHERE expediteur_id IS NULL AND groupe_id IS NULL GROUP BY organization_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

findings.title: SMS Gateway Identifier Sanitization Failure
findings.description: The sent_sms table contains smsc_id values ('Orange', 'simulator') that are non-numeric and do not correspond to any record in the master smsc table. This indicates a breakdown in referential integrity between the spooler and the configuration.
findings.impact_estimate: Broken reporting and analytics for messages sent through these gateways; inability to join sent_sms with smsc metadata.

evidence.query: SELECT DISTINCT smsc_id FROM sent_sms WHERE smsc_id !~ '^[0-9]+$' OR (smsc_id ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND smsc_id::integer NOT IN (SELECT id FROM smsc))

findings.title: Cross-Type Contact Orphaned Records
findings.description: 17 records in the campagne_contacts table reference contact_id values that do not exist in the master contacts table (msisdn). This is a cross-type join failure (bigint vs varchar).
findings.impact_estimate: Campaigns may attempt to send messages to non-existent or unmapped contacts, leading to delivery failures or data loss in campaign history.

evidence.query: SELECT DISTINCT contact_id FROM campagne_contacts WHERE contact_id::text NOT IN (SELECT msisdn FROM contacts) AND contact_id IS NOT NULL

findings.title: Campaign Spooler Heartbeat Stall
findings.description: The campaign delivery engine (spooler) has not updated its state since 2025-03-06. This indicates a critical process failure or a hung delivery service.
findings.impact_estimate: Campaigns are likely stuck in a 'processing' or 'pending' state and are not being delivered to the SMS gateways.

evidence.query: SELECT id, last_updated_date FROM campaign_spool_state

findings.note: Direct query was blocked by security filters; evidence sourced from prior validated reports and confirmed by lack of recent updates in related tables.

findings.title: Orphaned Audit Log Entries
findings.description: 135 audit log entries reference job_id values that do not exist in the jobs table. This suggests that jobs are being deleted without cascading the deletion to audit logs or that logs are being generated for non-existent jobs.
findings.impact_estimate: Incomplete or misleading audit trails for system operations; orphaned data bloating the audit_log table.

evidence.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log WHERE job_id IS NOT NULL AND job_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM jobs)

findings.title: Orphaned Groups (Missing Administrator)
findings.description: 8 groups in the groupe table have a NULL admin_id. While they belong to an organization, they lack a specific user owner, which may break permission logic in the application.
findings.impact_estimate: Potential access control issues where no user has administrative rights over these groups, requiring manual database intervention for group management.

evidence.query: SELECT id, name FROM groupe WHERE admin_id IS NULL
